title: Spectral distribution of Jacobi weighted histopolation matrices via GLT theory
summary: In this paper we study a weighted histopolation problem on $[-1,1]$ associated with Jacobi weights. In the first part of the present work we prove results in approximation theory, while in the second we analyze the resulting matrices from an asymptotic linear algebra perspective. More in detail, in the first part, given weighted cell averages, we construct a reconstruction operator based on weighted primitives of Jacobi polynomials and investigate the resulting discretization matrices.
